name: commodity_meta_values
query: SELECT DISTINCT currency, commodity_meta(currency, 'name') AS name, currency_meta(currency, 'export') AS export, commodity_meta(currency, 'price') AS price WHERE account ~ '^Assets:US:(ETrade|Vanguard)' ORDER BY currency
rows: iShares Core S&P Total U.S. Stock Market ETF
American Funds The Growth Fund of America Class R-6
Vanguard Total Bond Market Index Fund Institutional Plus Shares
notes: commodity_meta(currency, key), and its alias currency_meta, read the currency's commodity directive.
